name: Fix Bug
description: Bug fix workflow. Analyzes the bug, locates the issue, implements the fix, verifies with tests, reviews, and commits. Optimized for focused, single-issue fixes.

inputs.name: Bug Description
inputs.description: Description of the bug (error message, expected vs actual behavior)

inputs.name: Suspected File
inputs.description: File where the bug might be (if known)

inputs.name: Auto Commit
inputs.description: Set to 'true' to auto-commit after fix (default: false)

outputs.name: Root Cause
outputs.description: Identified root cause of the bug
